help.title: How leads work
help.intro: A lead is someone who asked about your studio but has not signed up yet. Here is how they reach you and how to follow up.
where_steps: Your enquiry form: a ready web page at your studio address, /inquire.
Links and the QR poster from "Get leads": each one is tagged, so you see the source (Instagram, WhatsApp, flyer…).
Your lead email address: anything sent or forwarded to it becomes a lead.
By hand: "Add lead" for phone calls and walk-ins.
form_steps: Copy your form link, or the link for a channel, and share it.
Download the QR poster for flyers and the studio wall.
Optional: add your own questions in Settings, or make a separate form for a class in Leads → Forms.
stages_steps: Each lead has a stage. Dance and class studios: new → contacted → trial booked → trial done → won or lost.
Change the stage on the Leads page as you go.
Set a follow-up date; overdue leads are marked.
enrol_steps: When someone enrols in a class with the same email or phone as a lead, the lead becomes "won" by itself.
If more than one lead could match, the Leads page asks you to choose.
You can also link a lead to an enrolment by hand.
daily_steps: Each morning you get one email listing leads to follow up that day, only when there are some.
Turn it off for yourself in Settings → Daily follow-up email.
privacy_steps: Enquiry details are kept only to answer the enquiry.
Marketing messages need the separate opt-in boxes on the form, which are never ticked in advance.
Sending someone your form link does not sign them up for anything.

tax.title: Class pricing
tax.description: How prices are stored and charged in Manage Studio.
tax.what_we_do_charge: Charges families the price you enter on each class.
tax.what_we_do_store: Stores one amount per class — the checkout total.
tax.what_we_do_display: Shows that same amount in the catalogue, enrolment, and payment flow.
tax.what_we_dont_title: What Manage Studio does not do
tax.what_we_dont_calculate: Calculate or add VAT at checkout.
tax.what_we_dont_incl_excl: Offer separate “incl. VAT” or “excl. VAT” price modes — always enter the amount families pay.
tax.what_we_dont_documents: Issue tax invoices or receipts — your payment and invoicing provider handles that.
tax.what_we_dont_status: Change osek patur / osek murshe status — update that with your provider or accountant when your business registers for VAT.
tax.grow_handles_vat: Grow splits VAT on the tax document it issues when a payment succeeds.
tax.icount_handles_vat: iCount splits VAT on tax documents issued with card payments.
tax.invoice4u_handles_vat: Invoice4U splits VAT on tax documents issued with card payments.
tax.invoicing_handles_vat: Your connected invoicing provider issues tax documents using the amount charged.
tax.class_price_rule: Enter each class price as the amount families pay. That is the amount charged at checkout.
tax.not_tax_advice: For tax returns, VAT reclaim, and business-status changes, work with your accountant.

stripe.title: Stripe

bundled.hub_description: Card payments and tax documents in one place
bundled.page_hint: Choose a provider below and enter credentials. Saving activates that integration for card payments and tax documents.

grow.title: Payments & invoices (Grow)
grow.description: Grow captures card payments and issues the tax document together. Enter your Grow (Meshulam) credentials below.
grow.saved_with_key: Grow credentials saved. Now add the webhook key below to your Grow account.
grow.webhook_description: Grow tells OpalSwift when a payment goes through. In your Grow account, set the notification address and webhook key below. OpalSwift ignores notifications without the right key, so payments will not be marked as paid until this is done.
grow.webhook_key_once: Copy this key into Grow now. For your security it is shown only once. If you lose it, make a new one.
grow.webhook_key_set: A webhook key is set. It is not shown again.
grow.webhook_key_missing: No webhook key yet. Payments cannot be confirmed until you make one and add it to Grow.
grow.webhook_rotate_hint: The previous key keeps working for 24 hours, so you have time to update Grow.

icount.title: Payments & invoices (iCount)
icount.description: iCount captures card payments and issues the tax document together. Enter your iCount company id, CC page id, and API token.

invoice4u.title: Payments & invoices (Invoice4U)
invoice4u.description: Invoice4U captures card payments and issues the tax document together. Enter your organisation API key and clearing company.

security.title: Security
security.description: Protect your admin account and take a copy of your studio's data.
